fact: International IDEA says Rwanda's voter register is compiled using the civil registry, and Organic Law 004/2018 has it updated from civil registry information.

The High Commission of Rwanda in Nigeria says voters in the diaspora can check where they are registered, and change their polling station, on the National Electoral Commission site amatora.nec.gov.rw using their ID number and mother's name.

The High Commission of Rwanda in Nigeria says everyone aged 18 or over with a Rwandan national ID card is automatically registered on the voters' list, with the polling location taken from the place the ID was requested.
Rwanda's National Electoral Commission released a final list of 9.7 million eligible voters after closing the update of the voter register on 29 June 2024.

The National Electoral Commission chair said all Rwandans aged 18 and over with national identification cards appear on the final voters' list released on 30 June 2024, and voters must show the national ID to vote.
